text: I needed to have my glasses repaired: one of the arms had come off due to the loss of the hinge screw. And this morning I searched the internet for an optical shop here in Chiang Mai. I found “The Vision Optic” in the neighborhood called “Nimman”. Upon arrival I was immediately impressed. The premises that house this sales center, preparation and repair of glasses and sunglasses, as well as the related activity of measuring eyesight, are large and luxurious. The assortment of frames is vast, and extends to almost all the most important brands in the world. I think anyone can find glasses to their taste. To be honest, the elegance of the environment intimidated me a little. But the kindness, simplicity and courtesy of the two young ladies who welcomed me immediately made me feel at ease. After a few minutes my glasses were returned to me repaired to perfection, and not without an accompanying smile from the gentleman who had done the work. When I asked how much I should pay for the repair, I was told nothing. I thanked him and left feeling grateful and satisfied. I don't think I need to add anything else.
